offering_description.value: Provides cloud-based software and data for pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device companies. Its products cover clinical, regulatory, quality, safety and commercial operations, including CRM and content management. Delivered as subscription software, with consulting and data services.

primary_products.value: cloud CRM software; clinical trial management software; regulatory and quality content management software; life sciences data products; safety software

primary_services.value: implementation and consulting; managed services; technical support and training

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device and consumer goods/chemical companies

end_markets.value: pharmaceuticals; biotechnology; medical devices; life sciences

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring fees for cloud software applications and data; service fees: professional services, implementation and training

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and hosts cloud applications and data sold to life sciences companies; service provider: implementation and consulting for customers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: Veeva Commercial Cloud, Development Cloud, Quality and Regulatory clouds, and data

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to life sciences companies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: customers are FDA-regulated, so software must support GxP validation and 21 CFR Part 11, data privacy rules apply
